title: StrategyFormulationRequest
description: Frozen proposer request for the strategy-formulation role module (OQ-03 sections 3 and 4). It holds the inputs the model reads; the host-side agent-dispatch/1 carries identity, execution and the result route, and binds this request by its digest. Request assembly fills every field from trusted host context. The subject decides the proposal kind: a seed source, a registered parent or none.

SeedTranslationSubject.title: SeedTranslationSubject
SeedTranslationSubject.description: Translate the source into a draft. Every source-to-draft difference and every unresolved assumption is declared.

ControlledRevisionSubject.title: ControlledRevisionSubject
ControlledRevisionSubject.description: Revise the registered parent. parent_hash is the application-owned hash of parent. claims are the source references, rationale, expected effect and requested tests recorded with the parent.

NewFamilySubject.title: NewFamilySubject
NewFamilySubject.description: Assemble a new family from permitted operators. It has no parent and draws on the exploration budget.
